title: Lightsaber Slugfest
front_description: Count Dooku and Obi-Wan duel until the younger Jedi warrior is injured and downed. The imperious Dooku is about to slay his downed foe when Anakin, revived and full of fury, crosses lightsabers with him. Armed now with two of the Jedi weapons (his own and Obi-Wan's), young Skywalker even Dooku with his remarkable strength, skill and command of the Force.
back_description: Hayden Christensen poses with two pre-ex Lightsabers for a publicity still.
